==Stats Overview==

|caption1="I won't pull back, I will press forward, like a centipede"

==Passive Ability: Bleed==
{{PAGENAME}} deals bleed damage to all enemies he attacks, dealing damage over time and greatly reducing HP regeneration for the duration of the bleed.

This makes him effective against Regen enemies. He's also recommended as a budget bleeder along with [[Hammergirl]]. His case is his SPA with no upgrades on is extremely cost-efficient on Shielded enemies.

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
